question: What gives all mantras their living power?
premises: This power is the heart-essence of all mantras.
Without this heart-essence, mantras are inert.
A body without a heart is like something living but not truly alive.
inference: Mantras have vitality only through this heart-essence, just as a body has life only through the heart.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'this power' depends on the immediately preceding verses (191-192).
plain_english: This power is indeed the heart-essence of all mantras. Without it, they are inert, like living beings without a heart.
